name: summarize-ops
title_zh: 一周事故报告进，运营周报出，改稿也认
tagline_zh: 事故报告散在十几个工单里，周五下午还要拼成一份给人看的周报。它按 summaries/ 里已有格式产出。
tagline_en: Incident reports scattered across tickets, and a Friday summary still due. It writes into your existing.
desc_en: Produce or revise the weekly ops summary from raw incident reports. Use whenever the task involves summarizing incidents, writing the weekly summary, or updating an existing summary in summaries/.
why_zh: 先读 summaries/ 里上一版的结构和口径，再决定是新增条目还是改写旧条目，所以周与周之间能对上。
why_en: It reads the prior version in summaries/ first, then decides whether to append or rewrite, so week-over-week stays consistent.
limit_zh: 只吃原始事故报告文本，不连监控、工单或告警系统去自己抓数据；输出只写到 summaries/ 下的 Markdown。
limit_en: Reads raw incident text only — no monitoring, ticketing, or alert integrations. Output is Markdown under summaries/; it sends no email and pushes no.
title_en: Raw incident reports in, weekly ops summary out.
